title: Means and weighted means
keywords: average averages mean total combined group marks score age class weights
content: A group with n observations and mean m has total n*m. A combined mean is the sum of group totals divided by the sum of group sizes.

title: Percent of a base
keywords: percent percentage increase decrease discount discounted sales tax markup reduction original price
content: p percent of a base B is B*p/100. A p percent increase multiplies the base by (1+p/100); a decrease multiplies it by (1-p/100). Successive changes multiply factors.

title: Profit, loss and marked price
keywords: profit profits loss price priced cost sell sold selling marked discount discounted merchant shopkeeper
content: Profit = selling price - cost price. Profit percent divides profit by cost price. Discount percent divides the price reduction by marked price.

title: Simple and compound interest
keywords: interest principal annum annual years deposit bank investment compounded simple amount maturity
content: Simple interest = principal * annual rate * years. For n equal compounding periods at rate r per period, the final amount is principal*(1+r)^n.

title: Ratios and proportions
keywords: ratio ratios portion proportion proportional shares divided share mixture ages twice parts
content: For a:b, write the quantities as a*k and b*k. If their total is T, k = T/(a+b). In a proportion a/b = c/d with nonzero denominators, a*d = b*c.

title: Mixtures and concentration
keywords: mix mixture mixing solution concentration salt water alcohol milk diluted evaporation evaporates evaporated litres liters
content: Track the amount of solute as volume times concentration, using consistent units. Added water and evaporation change the volume but preserve solute when only water is added or removed.

title: Distance, speed and time
keywords: speed speeds travel car bike run walk driver driving uniform distance time journey km mph
content: Distance = speed * time when speed is constant. Average speed is total distance divided by total time. Convert each time to the unit of the speed before multiplying.

title: Relative speed and crossing
keywords: train trains overtakes crossing crosses platforms bridge pole relative direction meet opposite length
content: Closing speeds add for opposite directions and subtract for the same direction. A train crossing a platform travels its own length plus the platform length relative to the platform.

title: Upstream and downstream speeds
keywords: river boat rowing current upstream downstream stream still water
content: If the boat's still-water speed is b and current speed is c, downstream speed is b+c and upstream speed is b-c. Use the corresponding speed for each leg.

title: Additive work and flow rates
keywords: finish work working job complete workers workers days pipes tank tap fill filling empty drain together hours
content: A worker finishing one job in t time units has rate 1/t. Sum rates for simultaneous work. Subtract a drain rate from a fill rate and multiply each rate by its active time.

title: Linear equations
keywords: equation equations unknown solve variable ages years old twice equal perimeter numbers
content: Define the same unknown throughout. For a*x+b=c with a nonzero, x=(c-b)/a. Check the recovered value against the original equation and required units.

title: Two-variable systems
keywords: system equations two unknown tickets coins ages prices men women total count
content: Use separate variables for distinct unknown quantities. For two independent linear relations, substitute one variable or eliminate it by adding a scaled equation.

title: Arithmetic and geometric sequences
keywords: series sequence successive consecutive terms arithmetic geometric progression sum
content: For arithmetic terms a, a+d, ..., term n is a+(n-1)*d and the sum is n times the mean of first and last terms. Geometric sequences have a constant ratio between adjacent terms.

title: Divisors, multiples and remainders
keywords: divisible divisibility least multiple highest greatest divisor factors prime remainder integer gcd lcm digit
content: A positive integer n divided by d can be written n=d*q+r with 0 <= r < d. Use prime exponents to find a gcd (minimum) or lcm (maximum) across numbers.

title: Place value
keywords: digit digits units tens hundreds reverse reversed sum digit place integer
content: In base ten, a two-digit integer with tens digit t and units digit u equals 10*t+u. Reversing the digits gives 10*u+t, when u is nonzero.

title: Counting arrangements and choices
keywords: ways permutations combinations arrangements order choose arrange select committee team books letters factorial
content: Multiply independent counts for successive choices. Selecting r entries from n distinct entries without order gives n!/(r!*(n-r)!); order matters for n!/(n-r)!.

title: Probability with equally likely outcomes
keywords: probability chances chance random selected dice die card balls coins toss without replacement event outcomes
content: For equally likely outcomes, probability is favorable count divided by total count. Without replacement, update counts after each draw. The probability of at least one event is one minus the probability of none.

title: Rectangles and unit area
keywords: rectangle square field garden area length width breadth perimeter fence tile dimensions
content: Rectangle area = length*width and perimeter = 2*(length+width). Convert each length before using area or perimeter formulas.

title: Circles and sectors
keywords: circle circles circular radius diameter circumference semicircle wheel revolutions arc sector degrees
content: Circle area = pi*r^2 and circumference = 2*pi*r. A sector of angle a degrees has a/360 of the corresponding full area and arc length.

title: Triangles, right angles and similarity
keywords: triangle triangular right hypotenuse sides similar angle tower elevation base tower shadow height
content: Triangle area is base*height/2. A right triangle has a^2+b^2=c^2 for legs a,b and hypotenuse c. Similar triangles have proportional corresponding lengths.

title: Angles of elevation
keywords: trigonometry angle elevation depression tower tan tangent height horizontal distance shadow
content: For a right triangle, tan(angle)=opposite/adjacent. An elevation angle is measured from horizontal, so tangent times horizontal distance equals the vertical difference.

title: Volume, capacity and total surface
keywords: volume capacity box cuboid cube cylinder cylindrical litres liters filled depth surface area
content: A prism with constant cross-section area A and height h has volume A*h. For a cylinder use A=pi*r^2. One liter equals 1000 cubic centimeters.

title: Unit conversions
keywords: convert conversion miles kilometers metres meters seconds minutes hours kmph mph litres liters units
content: Multiply by conversion ratios equal to one. Use 60 minutes per hour and 3600 seconds per hour. Converting km/h to m/s multiplies by 5/18.

title: Shares proportional to capital-time
keywords: partners partnership capital profit investment invests withdrew months shares business rent
content: If a partnership divides profit by contributed capital and duration, the weight of a contribution is capital times its active time. Divide each partner's total weight by all partners' total weight.
